slides.title: 60 seconds isn't enough.
slides.body: Heavy sets at 75 to 85% take more than your breath. You feel ready after a minute. Your legs aren't.

slides.title: Rest 2 to 3 minutes.
slides.body: Heavy triples and fives? Start a timer. Go when it beeps, not when the chat ends.

slides.title: Six minutes is too long.
slides.body: Rest that long and you cool off. The bar feels heavier than it is. Stay warm, stay near it.

slides.title: Resting is a job.
slides.body: Sit, breathe slow, sip water, pick one cue. Stand up 20 seconds before the beep.

slides.title: Conditioning is different.
slides.body: Short rest is the point in intervals. Long rest is the point on strength days. Don't train them the same.
